column5: GROUP: Terminal interpreter, storage: | - TI/storage_primitives.rs:2216-2224 with 4499-4501: a write to a `Scalar` endpoint whose cell is missing becomes an insert. 4534-4536: `retire_plain_locals` returns silently if the machine row is missing. 5486: appending rows without a root skips the "resident missing from replacement" check. 1521-1522.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, storage: | - TI/storage_records_and_arrays.rs:4754-4756: `capture` records nothing for opaque, byte-field and byte-array leaves; a host change to such a leaf has nothing to compare against there. 1235-1243: resident image cases are merged. 1785-1787, 2324-2341, 3085-3087.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, storage: | - TI/storage_references.rs:4408-4433: the return match checks `array_loan` and `primitive_storage` only when the expected side has them and does not mention the actual referent's `byte_owner` or `byte_region`. 4387-4435: a returned reference passes if any backing explains it, including invocation-origin backings built from every same-typed produced value (4336-4384). 1769-1780: `execute_access_boundary` returns `Ok(false)` when the boundary is in no access plan or the argument has no RAM; gap 028 read the caller (TI/engine_calls.rs:3345-3360): the call then goes to the non-observation refusal and otherwise to the host-effect path.
